test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

According to the chairman, his proposal was _________ than Mr. Jackson's.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. worse .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **compares **the chairman's proposal to Mr. Jackson's proposal. This is a comparative sentence.
 
• In **comparative **sentences, the correct **adjective **form to use is the **comparative degree** (e.g., worse, better, etc.) rather than the base form (e.g., bad) or the superlative degree (e.g., worst).
 
• The adjective** "worse"** is the **comparative degree** of "bad," which fits the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *According to the chairman, his proposal was **worse** than Mr. Jackson's.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Degree:**

 
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare two things.
 
• **Example:** This book is better than that one.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Degree:**
 
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare more than two things and indicate the highest degree.
 
• **Example:** This is the best book of all.
